mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.1 percentage point rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate AND rising demand (GDPC1) simultaneously signal an easing monetary cycle and robust economic growth, both driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when FEDFUNDS is declining and GDPC1 is rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the CPI inflation index predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market expectations adjust to lower inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns not positive despite CPIAUCSL declining in late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO supply index crosses above 102.4, indicating expanding supply conditions, S&P 500 forward returns become positive within 5 trading days as market anticipates sustained growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite INDPRO crossing above threshold in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Both a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150k AND an increase in the unemployment rate above 4.1% signal a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5k and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when both labor indicators cross their thresholds simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in HOUST demand index predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased demand supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns not positive despite HOUST rising over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in RSAFS demand index signals improving economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite RSAFS declining in post-shock recovery regime.
